name: Acontext
headline: Acontext: Context data platform
short_description: Acontext is a context data platform for building cloud-native AI agents. It enables developers to create, manage, and observe AI agents with enhanced context awareness. The platform supports agent development, observability, and memory capabilities, integrating with OpenAI and Claude agents.
author: memodb-io

sections.overview:
Acontext is a context data platform designed for developers building cloud-native AI agents with Claude and OpenAI. The platform enables you to create, manage, and observe AI agents with enhanced context awareness, providing built-in observability and memory capabilities. It addresses the challenge of maintaining rich contextual information across distributed AI agent deployments. Developers use Acontext to gain visibility into agent behavior and maintain persistent memory across interactions, improving agent reliability and performance in production environments.
Automate context storage and retrieval for AI agents handling large user interactions.
Track and summarize agent progress and user feedback in real-time.
Manage context windows effectively to optimize agent performance.
Run code and analyze data within a sandbox environment for rapid prototyping.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/memodb-io/Acontext`
sections.usage:
```
Create an AI agent using Acontext that can [SPECIFIC TASK] for [INDUSTRY]. The agent should have context awareness to handle [SPECIFIC CONTEXTUAL INFORMATION]. Include memory capabilities to retain [TYPE OF DATA] for up to [TIME PERIOD]. Ensure the agent integrates with [SPECIFIC TOOLS] for seamless operation.
```
Copy

```
Agent Name: Sales Support Agent
Description: This AI agent is designed to assist sales teams in the tech industry by providing context-aware support for customer interactions. The agent can handle customer inquiries, track previous interactions, and provide personalized recommendations based on the customer's history.
Context Awareness: The agent is aware of the customer's previous purchases, support tickets, and interaction history. It can use this information to provide more accurate and relevant responses.
Memory Capabilities: The agent retains customer interaction data for up to 6 months. This allows it to provide personalized support and recommendations based on the customer's history.
Integration: The agent integrates with CRM systems like Salesforce and HubSpot, as well as email and chat platforms like Gmail and Slack. This ensures seamless operation and easy access to customer data.
Observability: The agent's performance is monitored in real-time, with metrics such as response time, accuracy, and customer satisfaction tracked and analyzed. This allows for continuous improvement and optimization of the agent's performance.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
